race.comment: The grey's race. YOURE NOT THE KING (14) gets the nod after stringing together two wins this campaign, most recently beating Bryant in a BM72 at Warwick Farm after being well found in the market. Bjorn Baker is good at picking the right horses to bring down and he looks an ideal type with no weight and a good draw. ALABAMA FOX (6) is a danger, having won as favourite at Randwick Kensington after a narrow Warwick Farm second. Strong overall record and just needs some luck early from Lloyd to slot in. KAHHOF (5) is coming off a tidy win on heavy ground at Sale and can measure up from an ideal gate. CHAKADO (7) should also run well on speed and can figure in the money.
